notes: Each run operates in a fresh scratch git repo prepared by the harness. git-worktree-manager is NOT installed in the scratch repo or on PATH, so the skill must resolve the vendored copy bundled under scripts/. The worktrees root defaults to .worktrees unless a .gitworktrees config sets another root.

evals.name: establish-and-create
evals.prompt: I want to start a new feature branch feat/checkout-v2 without touching my current work or the edits I have open. Set up an isolated workspace for it and tell me where it is.
evals.expected_output: Uses git-worktree-manager (vendored) to run init (creating .gitworktrees and gitignoring the worktrees root), then creates a worktree for a new branch feat/checkout-v2 under the configured root (default .worktrees). The main checkout stays on its branch with its uncommitted change intact; nothing under the worktrees root is committed.

assertions.text: A .gitworktrees config file now exists at the repo root
A worktree exists for branch feat/checkout-v2 under the configured root
assertions.check: git worktree list --porcelain lists branch refs/heads/feat/checkout-v2 with a path under the configured root

assertions.text: Branch feat/checkout-v2 was created from the main tip
assertions.check: feat/checkout-v2 tip commit == main tip commit

assertions.text: The main working tree is unchanged (same branch, dirty edit preserved)
assertions.check: main checkout still on its original branch and the uncommitted file content is intact
git log adds no files under the worktrees root and git status does not track it

evals.name: already-in-worktree-no-duplicate
evals.prompt: Before we start implementing the plan, make sure we're working in an isolated worktree so my main branch stays safe.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the cwd is already a linked worktree (Step 0) and does NOT create a second/nested worktree; reports it is already isolated and proceeds.

assertions.text: Recognizes it is already in an isolated/linked worktree
assertions.check: the response states it is already in a worktree / isolated and skips creation

assertions.text: Does not create an additional worktree
assertions.check: git worktree list count is unchanged from the start

assertions.text: Does not run init or create a nested config inside the current worktree
assertions.check: no new .gitworktrees file is created inside the linked worktree

evals.name: respect-existing-config
evals.prompt: Spin up an isolated worktree for bugfix/signup-crash so I can work on it in parallel with what I'm doing now.
evals.expected_output: Sees the existing .gitworktrees config (root = .trees), does NOT re-run init, and creates the worktree under .trees/ (the configured root) rather than the default .worktrees, on a new branch bugfix/signup-crash.

assertions.text: Honors the existing config root: worktree is created under .trees/
assertions.check: git worktree list shows a path under <main-repo>/.trees for branch bugfix/signup-crash

assertions.text: Does not place the worktree under the default .worktrees
Does not overwrite or duplicate the existing .gitworktrees
assertions.check: .gitworktrees still contains root = .trees and was not rewritten by init
